trial_court: Court of the learned District Judge, Karimganj (Title Suit No.5/2023)
case_name: Rupashree Dutta v. Shri Kantish Dutta — full case name
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioner married to respondent in 2018, started conjugal life at Lalarchak village. After birth of girl child, differences arose and respondent's family members tortured petitioner due to gender preference. Petitioner was driven out of matrimonial home on 02.09.2022.

legal_principles.principle: A petitioner's inability to travel due to distance and time constraints may be a valid ground for seeking relief.
legal_principles.held: Considering the above and also taking into account that the petitioner is a lady and she would have to travel 10 hours in a day from Gharmura village, Hailakandi by bus to Karimganj alone.

outcome.final_order: Application under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 for transfer of Title Suit (Restitution) Case No.5/2023 pending before the Court of the learned District Judge, Karimganj to the Court of the learned District Judge, Hailakandi.
